candidates.name: TrackOffset
candidates.reason: RFC 9559 Appendix A describes this as a historic non-normative element. No concrete compatible-media requirement was established; adding it would not yet demonstrate useful behavior.

candidates.name: MP4 cached read position after a failing seek
candidates.reason: Both read_packet implementations invalidate cached position on read_exact failure, but not on seek failure. Need a synthetic MP4 and a Seek adapter that moves before returning an error to confirm whether a subsequent packet read can use the stale cursor.

candidates.decision: confirmed by two alternating measured pairs and accepted as FVID-0034
candidates.reason: Root build script reads only target OS, default media build script reads no files; neither narrows Cargo file watches. New fixtures/reports/tests appear to trigger expensive rebuilds. Confirm with real alternating Cargo checks after a documentation-only marker change; preserve Windows stack and optional legacy benchmark environment outputs.

candidates.name: Exposure integer/float reference gap
candidates.decision: not selected without a concrete compatibility requirement
candidates.reason: Existing ignored compatibility acceptance compares with a conversion pipeline that changes even identity 16-bit samples by up to 65. Inspect the intended precision contract before changing native identity-preserving behavior merely to match that pipeline. Existing gap reproduction tests pass.
